initialisation: each fold from scratch; no pretrained weights; fold-only scaling
fold_architecture: 2-layer bidirectional GRU with boundary head;12 epochs,16 steps,32 windows; AdamW.001,weight decay.0001,clip1,seed108+foldindex
verifier: same natural+high-head sampling as007; logistic20 epochs,seed91; only match-excluded predictions
selection: mean spell F1>recovery; misses<=292,FP<=112,merges<=66,actual short=0 and zero loss of same recovered reference spells
limitations: External validation reused; not fresh-test evidence.
Fold predictions excluded from fold weights and scaling, but all five matches are used to train the verifier.
Scratch-fold and fine-tuned final-backbone distributions may differ.
Provider labels are partial automatic supervision; no default promotion.
